mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate continued monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of 3-month declining FEDFUNDS periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points within a single month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in economic slowdown risks.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5 percentage points in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of UNRATE increase events exceeding 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both exceeding their 6-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both exceed 6-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 6-month MAs.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, characterized by decelerating GDP growth (GDPC1) and sustained housing starts (HOUST), the market prices in imminent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals strengthening manufacturing activity, correlating with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of 3-month rising INDPRO periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting expectations of aggressive monetary tightening that results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5 percentage points in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of CPIAUCSL increase events exceeding 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) within a single month indicates a tightening labor market, typically leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% and UNRATE falls > 0.1 percentage points in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS rose >0.5% and UNRATE fell >0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime, defined by INDPRO declining below its 6-month moving average, the market prices in reduced corporate output, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of manufacturing slowdown periods.
